patterns.name: Okta Brute Force / Password Spray Detection
patterns.description: Identifies single IP addresses generating more than 10 failed login attempts across multiple users within 10 minutes.
patterns.cql: #repo = "okta-audit-logs" Vendor.eventType = "user.session.start" Vendor.outcome.result = "FAILURE" | groupBy([source.ip], function=([count(Vendor.actor.alternateId, distinct=true, as=targeted_accounts), count(as=failed_attempts)])) | test(targeted_accounts >= 3 OR failed_attempts >= 10) | sort(field=failed_attempts, order=desc)

patterns.name: MFA Push Fatigue / Denial Bursts
patterns.description: Spots rapid sequence of MFA push challenges or user rejections indicating prompt bombing.
patterns.cql: #repo = "okta-audit-logs" Vendor.eventType = "user.authentication.auth_via_mfa" Vendor.outcome.result = /^(DENY|FAILURE)$/ | groupBy([Vendor.actor.alternateId], function=([count(as=mfa_failures), collect([source.ip, client.geo.city_name])])) | test(mfa_failures >= 3) | sort(field=mfa_failures, order=desc)

patterns.name: Administrative Role Grant or Privilege Escalation
patterns.description: Alerts when an administrator assigns privileged roles (Super Admin, Org Admin) to a user account.
patterns.cql: #repo = "okta-audit-logs" Vendor.eventType = /^(group.user_membership.add|user.account.privilege.grant)$/ | select([@timestamp, Vendor.actor.alternateId, Vendor.target.displayName, Vendor.eventType, client.ip])

patterns.name: Impossible Travel / Geo-Distance Velocity
patterns.description: Calculates unique countries or cities authenticating the same user identity within a 1-hour window.
patterns.cql: #repo = "okta-audit-logs" Vendor.outcome.result = "SUCCESS" | groupBy([Vendor.actor.alternateId], function=([count(client.geo.country_name, distinct=true, as=unique_countries), collect([client.geo.country_name, source.ip])])) | test(unique_countries > 1) | sort(field=unique_countries, order=desc)
